meta.name: remove-ai-slops
meta.description: Removes AI-generated code smells from branch changes or an explicit file list behind regression tests. Use when the user asks to clean up, deslop, or remove AI-slop patterns from recent changes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 清理代码中AI生成的坏味道与冗余痕迹
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果常担心AI助手留下的代码不够干净
copy.tagline_en: Clean up AI-generated code smells and redundant patterns in your recent changes
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often worry about messy code left by AI assistants

howto.what: 清理分支改动或指定文件里的 AI 生成代码味(如冗余注释、过度防御、死代码等):先用回归测试锁住行为,再分类多轮清理,最后过质量门禁复查,验证失败则回滚。
howto.when: 当你要求清理、deslop 或移除最近改动中的 AI-slop 模式时触发;默认范围是分支相对 merge-base main 的 diff,也可传入指定文件列表。

say.text: 把我这个分支的改动 deslop 一遍
say.note: 先锁回归测试,再分类清理并跑门禁

say.text: 清理 src/foo.py 和 src/bar.py 里的 AI slop
say.note: 按文件列表逐个处理,行为保持不变

say.text: 把这些改动里重复和过度防御的代码清掉,别改行为
say.note: 先删后简,验证不过就回滚

howto.what_en: Cleans AI-generated slop from branch changes or a given file list: locks behavior with regression tests, runs categorized cleanup passes, then quality gates, reverting if verification fails.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks to clean up, deslop, or remove AI-slop patterns from recent changes. Default scope is the branch diff vs merge-base main; an explicit file list can be passed.

say_en.note: Locks tests first, then cleans in passes

say_en.text: Clean up the AI slop in src/foo.py and src/bar.py
Remove the duplication and over-defensive code, keep behavior
say_en.note: Delete then simplify, revert if checks fail
